title: Model Serving Engineer
description:
Model Serving Engineer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Model Serving Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $74,000-$98,000 Annually
Experience Required: 7+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Model Serving Engineer to design, build, and operate high-performance, highly reliable inference platforms for serving large machine learning models in production. The role focuses on the systems engineering side of AI deployment, including request routing, batching, caching, autoscaling, GPU utilization, and end-to-end observability across diverse model workloads. The ideal candidate brings strong distributed systems and performance engineering expertise, has shipped serving systems at scale, and understands the trade-offs between latency, throughput, cost, and quality in ML serving.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.

• Six or more years of experience in distributed systems, infrastructure, or ML platform engineering.

• Strong proficiency in Python and a systems language such as Go, Rust, or C++.

• Deep experience operating high-throughput, low-latency services in production.

• Hands-on experience with LLM or large model inference frameworks such as vLLM or TensorRT-LLM.

• Strong understanding of GPU architecture, memory hierarchies, and accelerator utilization.

• Familiarity with Kubernetes, autoscaling, and modern cloud platforms.

• Experience with observability stacks including metrics, tracing, and structured logging.

• Solid grounding in performance engineering and capacity planning.

• Strong communication and incident response skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Open-source contributions to model serving infrastructure.

• Experience with multi-region or globally distributed AI serving.

• Familiarity with model quantization, distillation, and compression techniques.

• Exposure to FinOps for AI workloads and cost-efficient serving design.

• Experience supporting external-facing AI APIs at scale.

• Advance and close complex opportunities while maintaining pricing integrity, CRM discipline, and forecast accuracy.

• Establish yourself as a trusted partner to athletic departments, university leaders, conferences, and collegiate venue stakeholders.

• Become an internal expert on the collegiate athletics market, sharing customer needs, operational realities, competitive insights, and emerging opportunities.

• Help create repeatable playbooks for university-level, conference-level, and venue-level growth.

title: Product Manager - Auth
description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a Product Manager for Supabase Auth https://supabase.com/docs/guides/auth. You'll own the surface area that developers use to authenticate and authorize their end users and manage identity in their apps: email, phone and social login, passkeys and MFA https://supabase.com/docs/guides/auth/auth-mfa, enterprise SSO, the OAuth 2.1 server https://supabase.com/docs/guides/auth/oauth-server, auth hooks, and support for organizations and multi-tenant applications.

You'll work closely with the Auth engineering team and with partners across Product Management, Security, Design and GTM.

This role is ideal for someone who’s excited about building tools for millions of developers and who has a strong understanding of existing and emerging authentication practices and protocols.

WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

- You'll collaborate with customers of all sizes and expertise levels. Indie developers shipping a side project, startups choosing their first auth stack, SaaS teams designing multi-tenant access, and enterprises in security review.

- You'll own the problem statements and solution rationale behind the Auth roadmap. This means working with Engineering and Design to shape how Supabase crafts the developer experience for the problems you’ve prioritized solving.

- You'll define how Auth works for AI agents on Supabase: agents that sign users up, act on their behalf, and call APIs.

- You'll use data to understand how Supabase developers are using Auth features: where they succeed, where they get stuck, and what to tackle first.

- You'll keep Engineering, Design and GTM aligned. You'll own the plan of record for what's coming, why, and in what order.

YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

MUST HAVE

- 5+ years of Product Management experience on developer tools, or are an ex-founder with equivalent depth. You're comfortable commenting on an architecture doc, following a design discussion, and advocating for the user when trade-offs are required.

- Have shipped standards-based auth or identity products. You've owned OAuth/OIDC, SAML, SCIM, sessions or token design, and you know from experience where each one breaks for customers.

- Work comfortably with corporate buyers and with developers. You can work through a CISO's security review and an indie developer's bug report in the same week. You have intuition on which enterprise asks are real value-adding requirements and which are checkbox items.

- Are comfortable with Postgres and familiar with row-level security.

- Work async by default. Supabase is fully remote. You make decisions in writing and move work forward without meetings.

STRONG SIGNAL

title: Team Lead, Android Core Product - Omaha, NE, USA
description:
Remote
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
Over 50 million people use Speechify 's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading - PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites - into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify 's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.
Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting - Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.
Overview
Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.
This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own - that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.
We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.
What You'll Do

• Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team - from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight

• Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features

• Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval

• Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself

• Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through

• Keep the shared pieces in working order - tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear

• Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own

• Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out

• When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time

• Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out

• Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear

• Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless

• Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early

• Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team

• Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.
An Ideal Candidate Should Have

• 5+ years of software engineering experien

description:
About NOCD

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD , we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled clinician with advanced expertise in ERP and ACT to provide intensive, evidence-based virtual care for individuals with high-acuity OCD. A strong therapist candidate for a virtual OCD Intensive Treatment Service is a clinician with advanced training in CBT, ERP, ACT, HRT, and PE. title: Backend Engineer - Mission Operations Services
description:
Loft Orbital is looking for a Backend Engineer to join our Mission Operations Services (MOS) team. MOS owns the backend services that let Loft operators and customers command, monitor, and automate our satellite fleet through Cockpit, our mission control system. You’ll help build and scale the microservices that sit between ground and flight software, turning high-level intent into safe, reliable on-orbit operations.
 
You’ll work across multiple satellite platforms and collaborate closely with backend, flight software, embedded systems, test, and satellite operations teams. This is a hands-on engineering role where you’ll both build new systems and help debug live missions. We also offer SatDevOps training, so you don’t just write the tools - you actually use them to operate spacecraft.
 
If you’re excited about building backend systems that directly control satellites - and you like the idea of both shipping code and helping fly missions - we’d love to hear from you.

Who We Are: Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.
 
We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own - that doesn't shrink when you take this job. Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

As Employment Counsel for Airwallex in the Americas, you'll be a hands-on partner to People & Talent on the employment matters that carry the most risk. You'll help build the playbooks, policies, and processes a scaling employment function needs to give clear, commercially practical advice across the business.

- Own US employment law advice and coordinate guidance across other jurisdictions with Airwallex's external counsel panel, including contractor and EOR classification, cross-border remote work, mobility exposure, and conduct and remuneration matters in regulated entities.

- Build employment playbooks, templates, policies, and manager guidance that help the business handle employee matters consistently and pragmatically.

- Lead workplace investigations, employment disputes, agency charges, and litigation, including instructing and managing external counsel and associated legal spend.

You'll work from our San Francisco, New York, or Seattle office on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

ESSENTIALS

- A J.D. degree or foreign equivalent and active membership in at least one US state bar; California, Washington, or New York preferred.

- 5+ years of employment law experience at a leading law firm and/or in-house legal department, with demonstrated employment counselling experience beyond litigation alone.

- Experience advising on and coordinating employment law matters across multiple jurisdictions.

- Experience leading workplace investigations and managing employment disputes, agency charges, or tribunal matters.

- Experience advising on the employee lifecycle, including hiring, contracts and variations, performance management, accommodations, leaves, wage and hour compliance, and terminations.

- The ability to translate complex legal and risk issues into clear, succinct, and actionable guidance for non-legal audiences.

- Strong judgment and the ability to give commercially practical advice under time pressure.

- The ability to operate independently and pivot quickly within a fast-moving, changing environment.

- Fluent English; additional languages are a bonus given Airwallex's global footprint.

PREFERRED

- Experience at a fintech, payments company, or other highly regulated business.

- Experience with contractor classification, employer-of-record populations, or cross-border remote work and permanent establishment risk.

- Experience with California Labor Code matters.

- Experience advising on immigration, restructuring, or RIF execution across multiple consultation regimes.

- Experience with works co

title: Pooled Customer Success Manager
description:
ABOUT CODERABBIT

CodeRabbit is the leading AI code review platform, trusted by more than 17,000 customers and 150,000 open-source projects, conducting over 2 million code reviews each week. We build the symbiotic partnership between developers and AI that makes shipping fast software safe again, reviewing every pull request, IDE change, and CLI commit so teams can move quickly without breaking things.

 

We are a fast-moving, well-funded company, fresh off a $143M Series C at a $1.5B valuation - building Agentic Change Management, the control layer for software changes created by humans and agents. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck moves from implementation to judgment and helping human judgment scale is exactly the problem we exist to solve.

LOCATION: SAN FRANCISCO, BOSTON OR AUSTIN

ABOUT THE TEAM

CodeRabbit is the AI code review platform. Development teams install it on their repositories and it reviews every pull request, so it sits in the daily workflow of a large and fast-growing customer base. The Scaled Success team is responsible for the health of that base, and works alongside a program manager, a content and enablement specialist and a success analytics engineer. The pooled customer success team is new within it, and this is one of its first roles.

THE ROLE

You work a shared queue of customer accounts. Work arrives when a signal fires: onboarding has stalled, nothing has been configured, the only active user has gone quiet, a renewal is approaching, a cancellation has been started, or a team is using fewer seats than it has bought. You pick the case up, find out what is going on, get the customer configured and back to work, and close it out with a record the next person can read.

What you learn from the customers you work with feeds the playbooks, the automated campaigns and the triggers themselves. You work with the pooled team, the Content and Enablement Specialist, and the account executive who works expansion in the scaled lanes.

Few customer success teams run this way yet. You will learn how to move an account from default settings to a configured, renewing customer in a handful of conversations, and how to tell from the data which accounts need a person at all.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- The queue: pick up triggered accounts, respond within the team's standard, and resolve or route each one

- Configuration: take customers from default settings to a setup that fits their repositories, including Path Instructions, Learnings, pre-merge checks, IDE and CLI, and MCP

- Saves: work cancellation and non-renewal signals, understand the reason, fix what can be fixed, and record what cannot

- Renewals: run the renewal conversation where the signals say one is needed

- The expansion hand-off: when you see seat headroom or a buying signal, qualify it and pass it to the account executive with the context they need

- Playbook feedback: every case the playbook did not cover becomes a note, and patterns across those notes become new content, a new trigger, or new automation

- Case records: notes clean enough that anyone on the queue can pick up where you left off

YOUR FIRST QUARTER

- Complete product onboarding and work your first cases alongside the team

- Work the queue at the team's response standard

- Document the first ten cases where the playbook was missing or wrong, and propose the fix for each

- Contribute to the team's first readout: cases by trigger, resolution, and configuration movement on the accounts you touched

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- 2+ years in customer success, technical support or solutions for a developer-facing product

- You have worked a ticket queue or a shared inbox at volume and kept quality up

- You write clearly in tickets, email and documentation

- You want to know why a customer left, and you record it every time

- You are comfortable on a team where the playbook is still being written

NICE TO HAVE

- You can read a YAML configuration file, open a pull request,

Riskified empowers businesses to unleash ecommerce growth by taking risk off the table. Many of the world’s biggest brands and publicly traded companies selling online rely on Riskified for guaranteed protection against chargebacks, to fight fraud and policy abuse at scale, and to improve customer retention. Developed and managed by the largest team of ecommerce risk analysts, data scientists and researchers, Riskified’s AI-powered fraud and risk intelligence platform analyzes the individual behind each interaction to provide real-time decisions and robust identity-based insights.

Riskified is proud to work with incredible companies in virtually all industries including Booking.com, Acer, Gucci, Lorna Jane, GoPro, and many more .

We thrive in a collaborative work setting, alongside great people, to build and enhance products that matter. Abundant opportunities to create and contribute provide us with a sense of purpose that extends beyond ourselves, leaving a lasting impact. These sentiments capture why we choose Riskified every day. 

 

About the Role

We are looking for a technically skilled, customer-facing Integration Engineer to join our team at Riskified.

In this role, you will work closely with global enterprise merchants, primarily during the post-sales journey, while occasionally supporting pre-sales technical discussions.

You will be responsible for leading customers through the end-to-end technical integration process, from initial discovery and solution design to implementation, testing, and successful go-live.

The position combines technical expertise, customer engagement, solution architecture, and project management, requiring the ability to understand complex merchant environments and translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

What You'll Be Doing

• End-to-End Integration Ownership: Lead technical integration projects with international enterprise customers, from initial onboarding and technical scoping through implementation, testing, and production launch.

• Customer-Facing Technical Leadership: Act as the primary technical point of contact for merchants throughout the integration lifecycle, ensuring clear communication and alignment between technical and business stakeholders.

• Technical Architecture & Solution Design: Develop a deep understanding of each customer's technical architecture, infrastructure, and business flows, and determine how Riskified's APIs, SDKs, and solutions can be integrated effectively.

• API & SDK Integration: Guide customers through API and SDK implementations, troubleshoot integration challenges, and ensure adherence to technical requirements and best practices.

• Technical Project Management: Drive integration timelines, coordinate dependencies, identify potential risks and blockers, and ensure projects progress toward successful go-live milestones.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams, including R&D, Product, Customer Success, and Sales, to resolve technical challenges and deliver a seamless customer experience.

• Pre-Sales Technical Support: Occasionally participate in technical discovery sessions and solution discussions with prospective customers, evaluating integration feasibility and architectural requirements.

• Problem-Solving & Troubleshooting: Investigate complex technical issues, analyze API requests and responses, and provide praסctical solutions throughout the integration process.

 

Qualifications

• 3-5+ years of proven experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Integration Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Technical Implementation Engineer, or Technical Account Manager.

• Strong understanding of REST APIs, SDKs, HTTP protocols, JSON, webhooks, and system integrations.

• Ability to understand and analyze complex customer architectures, system dependencies, and end-to-end data flows.

title: Head of Product, Pulse
description:
At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need-and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

AI Proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework - be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

• Explorer (Level 1) - Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

• Builder (Level 2) - Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team

• Integrator (Level 3) - Embeds AI into products and processes at scale

Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

Role
Pulse is Sword Health 's cardiometabolic program - an AI-first, clinician-backed experience that members stay with for months, not days. We're looking for a Head of Product to own it end to end: the roadmap, the AI experience, and the engagement engine that keeps members coming back.
This is a builder's seat, not a caretaker's. You'll take features from zero to one and then scale them to hundreds of thousands of members, designing agentic and conversational experiences on top of frontier models - and the eval frameworks that prove they're safe, accurate, and actually working. You'll own the metrics that matter (activation, engagement, retention, clinical outcomes) and partner closely with clinical, ML, design, and commercial teams to move them.
What you’ll be doing
Product Strategy & Execution

• Own the product roadmap from pre-launch through scale, balancing zero-to-one innovation with one-to-100 optimization.

• Define and prioritize features that drive member engagement, retention, and clinical outcomes across 4-12 month care journeys.

• Establish clear product metrics, success criteria, and feedback loops to rapidly iterate and improve the member experience.

• Partner with clinical, regulatory, and compliance teams to ensure product decisions meet healthcare standards while maintaining innovation velocity.

AI Product Leadership

• Design AI-first product experiences that leverage agentic capabilities, conversational interfaces, and personalized recommendations to deliver exceptional consumer value.

• Develop and implement evaluation frameworks (evals) to measure AI model performance, accuracy, safety, and member satisfaction.

• Maintain deep understanding of available AI models (LLMs, fine-tuning approaches) and make strategic decisions about which models to use for which use cases.

• Collaborate with clinical, ML engineering and applied AI teams to ensure safety and quality and optimize model performance, latency, cost, and reliability in production.

• Leverage AI tools throughout the product development lifecycle to accelerate research, prototyping, testing, and go-to-market preparation.

• Stay current on AI capa

title: Tax Resolution Advocate
locationText: Denver, CO - Hybrid; Los Angeles, CA - Remote; Scottsdale, AZ - Hybrid
description:
About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff - payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR - so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) - because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy .

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role

This is an amazing opportunity to use your payroll expertise to reshape our customer experience. You’ll showcase your passion for customer support by resolving tax notices while delivering a world-class customer experience. You'll act as a detective and problem-solver discovering payroll discrepancies, researching tax laws, and identifying the root cause of notices. You will be working closely with tax agencies as well as our cross-functional partner teams to reach the best outcomes for our customers and provide feedback on tools that streamline the resolution process and prevent similar issues in the future. 

This role is very hands-on, with an emphasis on research and analysis, excellent communication skills, and first-principles problem-solving. A strong work ethic and desire to be part of the team is critical for success, as well as the ability to retain and apply large amounts of critical information. You must also possess and take pride in high attention to detail, organization, and task management, and be comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven business environment.

About the Team

The Tax Resolution team is within the Payroll, Tax & Compliance Services (PTCS) organization and is at the core of providing services that give our customers peace of mind. Tax Resolution exists to ensure impeccable delivery of key customer needs. There are thousands of critical operational tasks that are completed for our customers accurately and on time, every time, in a proactive and scalable manner. We collaborate, help each other, and work cross-functional in a positive environment.

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

• Provide exceptional service to our customers.

• Interact professionally with our customers via email and/or phone, simplifying the tax notice experience for our customers.

• Research and resolve payroll tax notices on behalf of our customers with guidance from more experienced team members.

• Provide clear and concise case documentation.

• Collaborate with our Compliance, Engagement, and Tax Operations teams.

• Communicate with government agencies to represent Gusto and advocate for our customers under supervision.

• Manage your time effectively to meet set goals.

• Actively use current AI tools in workplace applications

• Handle a queue of tax notices daily, including updating cases as needed, informing customers of any changes, and seeking assistance from peers on escalated issues.

• Participate in team meetings and provide support to fellow TaxRes Advocates.

Here’s what we're looking for:

• 2-4 years of payroll experience, notice resolution experience is a plus.

• Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

• AI Fluency: Capable of using current AI tools and have a mindset to help create and shape new AI tool functionality. 

• Capability to manage multiple priorities within a high-volume, fast-paced environment and adapt to shifting priorities daily.

• Commitment to personal high standards and a desire to contribute to team and comp

title: Account Executive, Product Sales - Payouts
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies-from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups-use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Product Sales is a team of deep functional and technical specialists who both lead and advise on deals for the most strategically important products in Stripe’s portfolio. The Payouts Product Sales team is tasked with engaging the largest most complex users and platforms in the industry, build world class programmable global money movement businesses, and providing solutions that address their cash flow and capital challenges, and help them. The team is lean, highly visible and highly cross-functional!

What you’ll do

As an Account Executive, Product (Payouts) at Stripe, you will use your sales and product expertise to help drive growth of Stripe’s payouts products solutions. You will collaborate with product, treasury, engineering and marketing teams to develop deep product and industry knowledge and drive strategic deals. You will be instrumental in leading in-depth product discussions with existing and prospect users Globally - and building and executing against our go to market strategy.

Responsibilities

• Lead complex new and renewal deals when related to Stripes payouts product suite and tailored solutions

• Deeply understand the sales process and competitors offerings in terms of payouts, with a strong emphasis to overcoming competition to win all deals 

• Synthesize and relay customer feedback and our findings to inform Stripe’s product roadmap

• Engage with Product, Marketing and Account teams to help amplify our growth trajectory globally 

Who you are

You are an adept sales, partnerships or BD person, capable of engaging in business-level and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organization, including CEO, CFO, CPO and Treasury. You are used to building value in competitive situations and enjoy working on products that require deep product understanding, combined with technical knowledge. You’re as comfortable working with clients as with internal stakeholders (including executives). You’re excited to become an expert and to share your knowledge. You’re an organized self-starter, an excellent communicator who is highly analytical and has a track record for improving the processes and organizations around you.

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply.

Minimum requirements

• 5+ years of sales or business development experience at a technology company and a track record of top performance, working specifically on enterprise or strategic accounts 

• 5+ years of experience selling payments to large enterprise merchants 

• A proven ability to build strong collaborative working relationships with business partners internally and externally

• The ability to deal effectively with ambiguity and thrive in an unstructured, fast-moving environment

• A proven ability to be a self-starter capable of driving business results without significant supervision

• An enthusiastic “roll up your sleeves” mentality

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Strong presentation skills, particularly for in-person meetings with multiple stakeholders

• Proven ability to lead complex negotiations involving bespoke commercial agreements

• Ability to understand complex technical requirements and craft solutions across multiple stakeholders

title: Demo Engineer
description:
ABOUT THIS ROLE

As Ashby’s first Demo Engineer, you’ll own the systems that make our demo environments reliable, current, and tailored - the infrastructure the entire go-to-market team leans on to show Ashby at its best. Today, AEs and SEs maintain and configure their own demo accounts by hand. That doesn’t scale: reps lose selling time, demos drift out of date, and every new product release widens the gap between what Ashby can do and what we can actually show live. Your job is to close that gap.

This is a net-new role. Right now, the work is split between ad hoc effort and a new set of disposable demo templates the Internal Platform team is building. You’ll own the layer on top of that foundation - customizing and extending those templates, generating realistic demo data, tailoring environments for specific verticals and new markets, and making sure every feature is demoable before it ships. You’ll sit within Solutions Engineering, reporting to the Global Head of Solutions Engineering, and partner closely with Internal Platform and Product teams.

Your work will be split roughly 70/30: about 70% owning, customizing, and extending the demo template system and the data and content inside it, and about 30% running demo readiness as a program - release readiness, documentation, and enablement so the GTM team always has current, credible demos to work with.

The best person for this job is genuinely hands-on technical - working with internal tools and configuration files, using APIs, and general data preparation - who gets energy from building leverage for a whole team rather than fixing one demo at a time.

YOU COULD BE A GREAT FIT IF:

- 🛠 You’re comfortable working in JSON, calling REST / developer APIs, using AI tools, and scripting to configure and customize environments.

- 🏗 You’re a builder, not just an operator. You get energy from creating systems and tooling that make a whole team more effective over time.

- 🎥 You care deeply about demo quality. You understand what makes a product demo land, and you’re thoughtful about data realism and the narrative a demo needs to support.

- 🧠 You have strong product intuition and can learn a deeply configurable product quickly, understanding how the different pieces connect.

- 🔁 You have an iterative mindset. You like testing what works, refining over time, and improving based on what you learn from the field.

- 🧩 You’re a systems thinker who would rather standardize and automate than manually repeat the same setup.

- ⚡ You’re comfortable with ambiguity and enjoy a 0→1 role where the infrastructure is still being built around you.

- 🤝 You partner well cross-functionally - with Engineering and with GTM - and can translate their needs into reliable systems.

- 💙 You have empathy for the go-to-market teams you support and the Talent Acquisition space they sell into.

BONUS POINTS FOR:

- 📊 You’ve built demo environments, demo data, or sandbox/trial environments at a SaaS company before.

- 🧰 You’ve written automation scripts or tooling to generate data or configure environments at scale.

- 🎬 You’ve built and maintained a library of reusable, templated environments or assets that others relied on.

- 🤝 You have experience with HR tech, ATS workflows, or recruiting operations.

EXAMPLES OF THINGS YOU’LL WORK ON:

- 🧱 Own the scaled demo system - customize and extend the demo environment infrastructure to support the GTM team.

- 🗂 Generate realistic demo data - standardize and automate how demo environments are populated to eliminate manual setup.

- 🎯 Build vertical- and market-specific demos - create tailored content for target verticals and additional languages as we move upmarket and expand internationally.

- 🚦 Own demo readiness for new releases - make sure every feature is correctly configured and demoable in demo environments before it ships to GA.

- 🧪 Stand up trial and sandbox environments - create templated environments prospects can use to test Ashby

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets - the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

THE OPPORTUNITY

The AI Engineering team at 9fin is building the next generation of AI capabilities that will power our products for years to come. We're looking for an Engineering Lead to lead the GenAI Platform team, building the shared foundations that enable product teams to develop and operate AI-powered products and agents.

Reporting to the Head of AI, you'll own the team's development, technical direction and delivery. You'll shape the platform strategy and roadmap, working with product and engineering teams to understand their needs and decide where shared capabilities will have the greatest impact.

You'll combine people leadership with strong engineering judgement, staying close to architecture and code while giving engineers the support and autonomy to do their best work.

- Make the GenAI platform easy for other engineers to adopt and extend through effective APIs, tooling, documentation and clear ownership.

- Partner with AI and evaluation specialists to establish how platform changes are tested, measured and released.

- Work with product, engineering and security colleagues to resolve dependencies, communicate trade-offs and turn emerging needs into sustainable capabilities.

WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT

You'll join an evolving GenAI platform with substantial scope to shape its next stage. You'll help decide what the platform should provide, which approaches to adopt and how the team should grow as 9fin's AI ambitions develop.

Your impact will reach across product teams. By building shared capabilities that engineers trust and choose to use, you'll help teams deliver AI products more quickly and operate them with confidence.

You'll own both people leadership and technical direction, developing the team while remaining closely involved in the engineering decisions that determine the platform's success.

- Оформлювати гіпотези у ТЗ для дизайнерів і писати текстовки: хедлайни, дескрипшени, UGC-сценарії.

- Запускати тести разом з User Acquisition менеджерами, аналізувати результати і робити висновки для наступної ітерації.

title: Sales Executive Small Business
description:
Sobre nós ✨

- Reportar os status dos fechamentos de vendas junto a liderança comercial

title: Campaign Creative, Product Marketing
description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems - robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

*Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers.

ABOUT THE ROLE

*Open to hiring remote across North America - we also have offices in NYC, London, San Francisco, Paris and Seattle.

We’re looking for a Creative with a focus on campaigns for Product Marketing. This is not a growth role. It’s a hands-on campaign creative role for someone who makes the work themselves, with AI as their primary medium. You’ll own full-funnel launch campaigns for Runway’s products, features and research: launch films, key visuals, landing pages, lifecycle emails, onboarding flows and everything in between. You’ll report to the Creative Director of Product Marketing.

We’re open to creatives who lead with art direction or with copy. What matters is that you make the work yourself and can move across both. Your work will directly shape how people discover, understand and adopt what Runway builds. That means work with real taste that stops people mid-scroll, makes new research feel tangible, and turns curiosity into first use. You’ll also help build the workflows and automations that let a small team ship at the pace of the product. You’ll partner closely with product marketing, design, research, growth and product teams.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Build full-funnel launch campaigns end to end: the idea, the script, the boards, the generation, the edit, the finish.

- Make launch films, key visuals and campaign systems that hold up next to the best brand work in the world.

- Turn research breakthroughs into work people outside the field can feel, not just read about.

- Extend each campaign across every surface (landing pages, social, email, in-product) without losing the idea.

- Work at the pace of the product: several launches at once, fast timelines, quality never optional.

- Build the machine behind the work. Turn what you make into reusable prompts, workflows and automated pipelines, so every campaign starts further ahead than the last.

- Treat every new model as new creative territory, and show the team what’s now possible before anyone asks.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

- 4+ years making creative at an agency, studio or brand, with real campaigns shipped for real clients.

- A portfolio that proves taste first. AI-generated or AI-assisted work should be central to it.

- Fluency with image and video models, plus the craft tools to finish (editing, compositing, design).

- Art direction instincts: casting, styling, light, composition, type and pacing.

- A strong lead discipline (art direction, motion/edit or copy) and comfort across the others.

- A builder’s mindset. You’ve chained tools together, automated the repetitive parts, or built workflows others use.

- The range to move from a cinematic launch film to a single perfect frame in the same week.

BONUS POINTS

- Experience launching creative tools, AI

Required

title: Retention & Recovery Lead
description:
Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you

The role

The Retention & Recovery Lead owns one pipeline that follows every merchant from the first sign they might leave, through retention, a well-run exit and collections, to write-off or debt sale.

Today we treat churn and collections as separate problems, and neither has a clear owner. In practice they are usually the same merchant at different points in time: a merchant who goes quiet in March becomes, by June, an unpaid fee, a terminal still in the field and a balance nobody is chasing. Collections activity also sits in pockets across the business, from unpaid subscriptions and fees, negative balances and chargebacks to terminal recovery, dissolved companies and fraud losses. As our credit products grow, so will the need.

You’ll bring all of this together under one strategy, one queue and one set of metrics. We want someone who knows collections and its pain points, and who approaches the whole lifecycle with a product and design mindset: redesigning journeys end to end, and deciding where AI and automation belong and where people add the most value. You’ll start hands-on and build a small credit control team as the capability grows.

What you’ll do

- Own the retention-to-recovery pipeline end to end, from the first churn signal to write-off or debt sale, running from one prioritised queue with one set of definitions.

- Work with our data team to build and run an AI retention engine that identifies merchants heading towards churn, recommends the next best action for each and puts them in a queue to be worked. Prove what works with holdout groups, and do more of it.

- Agree with Commercial how save conversations are delivered, and make sure our own risk actions, such as held settlements, are weighed before they push a good merchant out.

- Design a proper exit for every merchant who leaves: a recorded reason, fees stopped, terminal returned, final balance netted and a final statement, so merchants do not need to contact Customer Relations to close their account.

- Build automated collections that start the day a balance turns negative: settlement netting, direct debit, card on file, payment links and payment plans. Journeys run through the Teya app and portal first, with phone as the exception.

- Run managed and external recovery for larger balances: credit control, payment plans, an agency panel, write-off thresholds and, as a last resort, debt sale.

- Own the recovery strategy for fraud-related balances with Fraud Operations and Legal. They keep investigation and legal action; you make sure every balance has a recovery route and a priority.

- Run the existing book as a separate remediation project with its own end date, so it does not pull focus from the new flow.

- Connect the work of Billing, Payments, Logistics (terminal recovery), Credit, Customer Relations and the termination and withheld funds process into one joined-up flow.

- Define and own the pipeline’s metrics, report them monthly, and feed what you learn back into onboarding, pr

- Support multidisciplinary coordination using Navisworks, Autodesk Construction Cloud, BIM 360, Revizto, or similar collaboration platforms.

- Prepare model views, coordination packages, exports, and documentation for design reviews and stakeholder meetings.

- Support model-based quantity takeoffs, equipment tracking, asset information, room data, and design progress reporting.

- Review consultant and contractor BIM deliverables for quality, coordination, completeness, and compliance with project BIM standards.

- Help maintain digital design assets that support planning, design development, construction coordination, and operational handoff.

Discipline Focus Areas

CIVIL BIM DESIGNER

- Develop site models including grading concepts, access roads, utility corridors, stormwater systems, underground duct banks, and civil infrastructure.

- Coordinate civil infrastructure with building footprints, substations, generators, cooling equipment, underground utilities, and site constraints.

title: Trusted Access Operations Specialist
description:
About the team

Trusted Access helps eligible customers access and use advanced AI capabilities with appropriate safeguards. Within User Safety & Risk Operations, we connect customer onboarding, eligibility review, access provisioning, and support into a service customers can navigate with confidence.

We work with Product, Engineering, technical support, regional operations, and customer-facing teams to resolve difficult access problems and improve the systems behind them. Our work combines sound judgment on individual cases with better products, clearer guidance, and automation that reduces unnecessary friction.

About the role

We’re looking for a senior operator to own and improve the customer access workflow for an assigned Trusted Access program. You will connect application and eligibility review, approvals, appeals, provisioning coordination, and support so customers can reach a clear, reliable outcome.

Your primary focus will be improving how the program works. You’ll use complex customer cases to uncover recurring problems, then deliver product, automation, self-service, and support-process improvements. You’ll also own difficult eligibility and access escalations, helping customers and account teams understand what is blocking progress and driving the right partners toward resolution.

This role combines independent workflow ownership with hands-on operational judgment. Success means customers reach usable access with fewer avoidable delays, decisions remain accurate, and the workflow runs reliably through the people and systems you enable.

In this role, you will:

- Own the operational workflow for an assigned Trusted Access program, from application through confirmed access and subsequent changes. Identify where customers get stuck and prioritize improvements by customer impact, risk, and effort.

- Investigate complex eligibility, onboarding, and access cases. Reconcile approval, verification, account, workspace, and provisioning records; apply approved requirements within your authority and bring exceptions to the appropriate decision-maker.

- Drive customer and account-team escalations through resolution. Establish the blocker, maintain clear ownership across handoffs, communicate realistic next steps, and confirm that the customer can use the intended capability.

- Turn recurring case patterns into product and process changes with Product, Engineering, and customer-facing partners. Define the problem and requirements, help validate the fix, and measure whether it reduced repeat contacts or manual work.

- Build guidance that makes reliable resolution repeatable: support playbooks, help-center content, training, and quality checks. Enable frontline and outsourced support teams to handle more cases accurately and independently.

- Use data to distinguish fast ticket closure from better access outcomes. Diagnose delays, rework, and decision errors, and use the findings to refine your workflow and priorities.

- Develop and validate AI-assisted workflows and automation with technical partners. Establish checks, human review, and fallback paths appropriate to the decisions involved.

- Maintain clear documentation and qualified backup across programs. Share what you learn so improvements continue working when another specialist takes ownership.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Have independently owned and improved customer support, onboarding, access, risk, or product-operations workflows in a complex service environment.

- Can show durable improvements you delivered through product changes, self-service, automation, or partner enablement, with evidence of adoption and better customer outcomes.

- Exercise sound judgment when records conflict, requirements are unclear, or customers need urgent help. You can separate what the evidence supports from what still needs an authorized decision.

title: Initiativbewerbung
description:
Überraschend überzeugend!
Mit einer klaren Vorstellung oder einer besonderen Qualifikation musst du nicht auf eine passende Stellenausschreibung warten. Ergreife selbst die Initiative und schick uns deine Bewerbung auf deine Wunschposition - selbst wenn die Stellenbeschreibung nicht zu 100 % passt. Auch Berufsanfänger*innen sind bei uns herzlich Willkommen. Bei deiner Bewerbung solltest du uns bestenfalls ein genaues Bild davon geben, welche Fähigkeiten und Qualifikationen du hast und in welchem Arbeitsbereich oder welcher Fachabteilung du das Paragon-Team bereichern möchtest.
Requirements
Wir haben aktuell nicht die passende Stelle für dich online?
Dann bewirb dich doch gerne initiativ bei uns! Dazu sind zunächst nur dein Lebenslauf und Anschreiben notwendig. Dabei gibst du bestenfalls auch gleich deine Wünsche und Vorstellungen im Hinblick auf Stundenumfang, Arbeitsort und Arbeitsfeld an. Das hilft uns dabei, deine Initiativbewerbung besser zuordnen und für passende Stellen prüfen zu können. Haben wir aktuell keine passende Stelle für dich, heißt das noch lange nicht, dass der Prozess damit beendet sein muss. Gerne nehmen wir dich in unseren internen Bewerberpool auf und kontaktieren dich, sobald wir eine neue Stelle haben, die für dich passen könnte.
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung mit deinem Lebenslauf, den Rahmenbedingungen (gewünschtes Arbeitszeitmodell, Gehaltsvorstellung sowie frühestmögliche Verfügbarkeit) und Angaben zu deiner gewünschten Tätigkeit!
